auth_details: OAuth2 with client ID/secret; also require Trakt-Api-Key header (client ID) and Trakt-Api-Version: 2 on all requests
rate_limits: 1000 GET requests / 5 minutes (app-level); authenticated users: 1 POST/PUT/DELETE per second; VIP higher; X-Ratelimit headers; 429 + Retry-After
description: Trakt.tv provides a REST API for tracking what users watch, discovering TV shows and movies, managing lists and collections, and syncing watch history across apps. Developers use OAuth2 or API keys to build media clients, scrobblers, and recommendation tools.
